TG01.name: Gene Silencing
TG01.description: Reduce expression of a pathogenic gene or transcript through transcriptional or post-transcriptional mechanisms.

TG02.name: Gene Activation / Upregulation
TG02.description: Increase endogenous gene expression or restore production of a beneficial protein.

TG03.name: RNA Editing / Correction
TG03.description: Repair pathogenic RNA sequences or correct disease-causing RNA alterations without modifying genomic DNA.

TG04.name: RNA Processing Modulation
TG04.description: Modify RNA maturation, including splicing, polyadenylation, transcript processing, and RNA stability.

TG05.name: RNA Neutralization
TG05.description: Neutralize toxic RNA molecules or block pathogenic RNA–protein interactions without necessarily degrading the RNA.

TG06.name: Translational Regulation
TG06.description: Increase or decrease protein synthesis by regulating mRNA translation without altering RNA abundance.

TG07.name: Isoform Engineering
TG07.description: Generate therapeutically beneficial transcript or protein isoforms by modifying RNA processing or transcript architecture.

TG08.name: Protein Replacement
TG08.description: Restore protein function by delivering therapeutic RNA molecules that encode the missing or defective protein.

TG09.name: Protein Function Modulation
TG09.description: Modulate protein activity directly using RNA molecules that bind and regulate protein function rather than gene expression.
